module: Existing ESP32-S3 N16R8 dev board, same board style reportedly used on Gladiator
source: Owner-reported physical dimensions during chat; measurement instrument not restated for this batch. Do not silently replace unverified values with catalog dimensions.
status: partial physical survey; no CAD dimension should be treated as verified beyond its stated confidence

coordinate_reference.described_view: Component side facing viewer, antenna at top, USB connectors at bottom (opposite orientation from earlier template's USB-at-top sheet)
coordinate_reference.edge_reference: All lengths exclude connector overhang unless noted; exact CAD coordinate origin and handedness must be reconciled with the repo's measurement template
coordinate_reference.z_reference: PCB underside = z 0; PCB top = z 1.55 mm; tallest USB/module top = z 4.70 mm. Excludes unmeasured underside joints, pins, and soldered leads.

antenna.notes: Width of the antenna overhang; precise attachment geometry/centering still unmeasured.

overhang_past_usb_end_of_pcb_mm.notes: Neither USB connector overhangs the PCB

usbs.notes: Left/right USB x-positions not directly measured; centering cannot be asserted.

esp_module.relative_position: Directly below antenna section (owner description); exact X/Y offsets not measured
esp_module.notes: Module cover and USB were reported as same overall height; do not add PCB thickness again.

row_gap_inside_edges_mm.notes: Between inner edges of pins, not center spacing

pin_heads_row_spacing_mm.notes: Owner: 'pin heads are 25.5, as far as I can tell'; interpreted as approximate row spacing but reference not unequivocally center-to-center

gpio_headers.header_position: Practically flush with the PCB side edges (owner estimate)

closest_pin_head_from_usb_end_mm.notes: Owner: 'pin head is 2mm from the lower, usb edge'; not confirmed to be pin center

pin_pitch_mm.notes: 2.54 mm is a hypothesis, not a measurement

dimensions_mm.notes: Owner corrected an earlier 4.9 x 49 typo; square

reported_top_to_top_usb_offset_mm.reference: Top edge of LED relative to top edge of left USB connector; direction/coordinate interpretation not independently verified

led.notes: LED x/y location must not be converted to the CAD datum without confirming which side/view is meant.

clearance_between_top_of_esp_module_and_.notes: Owner estimated minimum around 19 mm and deliberately selected 20 mm. This is reserved space, not a physical measured part. The exact pins referred to are not yet identified.
